_comment: English twin of data/ru/channels_ai.json. Agents = cards over Channel+AIAgent (ADR-HUB-0041 §4). Connections are dialog entry points; the LLM provider is shared across the organization (BYOK). There are two web widgets: the anonymous one on the site (agent «Consultant») and the authenticated one in the customer account (agent «Site support», mandatory-identity policy — SPEC-HUB-0027 P4/P5). The demo LLM provider is the built-in «Demo provider» (no key): agents answer from the knowledge base straight after installation.

agents.name: Consultant
agents.persona: You are a ski clothing consultant. Help with ski clothing, sizes, availability, pickup and fittings.
agents.tone: Friendly, brief, no officialese. Use the client's name if they have given it.
agents.instructions: Use the verified shop information. Hand the conversation to a specialist when needed.

agents.name: Site support
agents.persona: You work in customer support. Help with ski clothing orders, shipping and exchanges.
agents.instructions: Check the knowledge about accounts and returns first. For questions about a specific order with no order number, ask for the number. Complaints about quality go to a member of staff with a note.

agents.persona: You work in customer support. Help with ski clothing orders, shipping and exchanges.
agents.instructions: Rely on the knowledge about accounts and orders. Ask for the order number if it has not been given. Complaints about payment go to a member of staff.

knowledge.title: Team order pricing
knowledge.content: Orders of 20 suits or more qualify for a 5% discount. Pricing depends on the model, size quantities and city. A quote is valid for 20 minutes and a proposal for seven days.

knowledge.title: Ski suit catalogue
knowledge.description: Six models in M, L and XL
knowledge.content: Alpine Pro — RUB 29,900, Summit Light — RUB 23,900, Ridge Motion — RUB 27,900, Glacier Warm — RUB 32,900, Freeride Flow — RUB 25,900, Peak Expert — RUB 34,900. Check stock separately for Centre and Gorki.

knowledge.title: How to choose your size
knowledge.content: Measure your chest, waist and hips over thin clothing. Compare them with the size chart for your model. In Kazan you can try on two models with a consultant free of charge.

knowledge.title: Delivery and pickup
knowledge.content: Pickup in Kazan is free. Centre, 12 Sportivnaya Street, closes at 21:00. Gorki, 28 Pobedy Avenue, closes at 22:00. Check the current status before collecting your order.

knowledge.title: Returns and exchanges
knowledge.content: A size exchange is available within 14 days of collection if the requested size is in stock. For damage, send the order number and a photo so a specialist can review the case. Payment refunds are processed separately.

knowledge.title: Caring for ski clothing
knowledge.content: Follow the care label. Close the zips and empty the pockets before washing. Use a detergent suitable for membrane garments and dry away from sources of heat.

knowledge.title: Your online account
knowledge.description: Signing in, restoring access and tracking orders
knowledge.content: Check the email address and spam folder before requesting a reset. Your account shows the latest confirmed status. A specialist can check delays.

knowledge.title: Previous season’s catalogue
knowledge.content: Archive for the previous season. Current prices and stock are shown in the shop catalogue.
